sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in C.T. Case No.1669 of 2022, pending in the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Jajpur, arising out of Binjharpur P.S. Case No.442 of 2022.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned District & Sessions Judge, Jajpur by order dated 24.11.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 23.07.2022 on the accusation of commission of offence under Section 498/302/304B/34 of IPC read with Section 4 of the D.P. Act.
5.
It is stated that after investigation charge sheet has been filed on 18.11.2022 under Section 498A/306/34 of IPC.
6. Learned counsel for the State on verification of the post mortem report submits that there is no external injury except ligature mark which is conformity with the manner of suicide.
7. Taking into account the filing of charge sheet, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
